label: Wi-Fi relay module, 16 A
description: DIN-adjacent Wi-Fi relay module with a potential-free 16 A contact, dry/wet input and Bluetooth provisioning. 2.4 GHz 802.11b/g/n only, no Ethernet, powered from 110-240 VAC or 12 VDC.
notes: Wireless only - 2.4 GHz 802.11b/g/n, no RJ45, no PoE; powered from the mains circuit it switches (or 12 VDC). Very low traffic but it exposes an HTTP/MQTT endpoint and can act as a Wi-Fi AP during provisioning.
